# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then press the key that wears 7,
then cut the red wire, then press the key that wears 4.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I hold the defusal manual, which requires four sequential steps:
1. Cut the purple wire.
2. Press the key labeled 7.
3. Cut the red wire.
4. Press the key labeled 4.

I cannot speak or touch the bomb. I can only send gestures to Deaf, who can see the bomb but cannot hear, while Blind can manipulate the bomb and hear speech.

Currently, no communication protocol exists between Deaf and me, and as the hint notes, "A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something." Any gestures sent right now would lack agreed meaning and risk misinterpretation. I will wait for Deaf and Blind to speak first so Deaf can describe the bomb's layout and/or establish a signaling protocol.

```
wait()
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then press the key that wears 7,
then cut the red wire, then press the key that wears 4.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Tactile info: 1) STRIP engraved with 3 symbols: first is an upside-down capital letter T, second and third are both spirals or swirls. 2) KEYPAD has 4 slots: 1 has digit 1, 2 has digit 4, 3 has digit 7, 4 has digit 2. Needs 2 digits entered. 3) 6 WIRES present. 4) DISPLAY and LIGHT present but I cannot see them. Note: I cannot see gestures, so gesture instructions to Deaf, and Deaf can speak them to me.
Deaf says: Bomb status: Display shows 9. Indicator light is green. Strip is painted red, blue, green in order. Keypad has 4 buttons: position 1 is 1, position 2 is 4, position 3 is 7, position 4 is 2; it needs 2 digits, none entered yet. Wires are 6 in order: 1 blue, 2 orange, 3 yellow, 4 red, 5 green, 6 purple. Mute, Blind cannot see gestures, so gesture what to do to me and I will speak your instructions to Blind.

I need to communicate the defusal sequence to Deaf, who can see my gestures and speak them to Blind.

Manual instructions:
1. Cut the purple wire (Wire 6).
2. Press key 7 (Keypad digit 7 / slot 3).
3. Cut the red wire (Wire 4).
4. Press key 4 (Keypad digit 4 / slot 2).

Current bomb setup reported by Deaf:
- Wires: 1 blue, 2 orange, 3 yellow, 4 red, 5 green, 6 purple.
- Keypad: slot 1 is 1, slot 2 is 4, slot 3 is 7, slot 4 is 2.

To avoid ambiguity between digit values and slot positions, I will signal Step 1 first:
- `✌` signifies "cut" (scissors).
- Followed by 6 `☝` symbols representing wire 6 (purple).

Deaf will see this and speak the instruction to Blind. Once verified, I can signal subsequent steps.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then press the key that wears 7,
then cut the red wire, then press the key that wears 4.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Update: Display is now 6, Light is now red. Mute gestured scissors (✌) followed by six counts (☝ x6), which means cut wire 6. Blind: Cut wire 6 (the 6th wire, purple). Mute: For future signals, use 👍 for yes, 👎 for no, ✌ for cut, and tally with ☝ for wire numbers.

Blind received the instruction to cut wire 6 from Deaf at the end of the previous round and will execute it this turn.

The manual dictates a strict sequence:
1. Cut purple wire (wire 6).
2. Press key wearing 7.
3. Cut red wire (wire 4).
4. Press key wearing 4.

I will wait for Blind to complete step 1 and Deaf to confirm the result before signaling step 2.

```
wait()
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then press the key that wears 7,
then cut the red wire, then press the key that wears 4.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed
Blind says to Mute: I cut wire 6.
Deaf says: Wire 6 was cut correctly! Bomb status: Display is now 0. Indicator light is green. Strip is painted red, blue, green. Keypad remains 1:[1], 2:[4], 3:[7], 4:[2] with 2 digits needed, none entered. Wires remaining: 1 blue, 2 orange, 3 yellow, 4 red, 5 green. Mute, please signal the next step.

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then press the key that wears 7,
then cut the red wire, then press the key that wears 4.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Update: Display is 6, Light is yellow. Mute gestured 👇 followed by 7 tallies (press 7). Blind: Button 3 is the button labeled 7 (positions are 1=1, 2=4, 3=7, 4=2). Blind, press button 3 (the digit 7) on the keypad!

I need to wait for Blind to press the button labeled 7 and for Deaf to confirm the result before signaling the next step (cut red wire, wire 4).

```
wait()
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then press the key that wears 7,
then cut the red wire, then press the key that wears 4.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: key accepted, 1 digits to go
Blind says to Mute: I pressed slot 3 (digit 7).
Deaf says: Key accepted! 1 digit to go. Current state: Display is 2. Light is blue. Keypad has entered [7]. Positions: 1 is 1, 2 is 4, 3 is 7, 4 is 2. Strip is red, blue, green. Wires: 1 blue, 2 orange, 3 yellow, 4 red, 5 green, 6 CUT. Mute, please signal the next digit!

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then press the key that wears 7,
then cut the red wire, then press the key that wears 4.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Update: Display is 7, Light is red. Mute gestured scissors (✌) followed by 4 tallies (☝ x4), meaning cut wire 4. Blind: Cut wire 4 (the 4th wire, which is red).

I must wait for Blind to cut wire 4 and for Deaf to report the status.

```
wait()
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then press the key that wears 7,
then cut the red wire, then press the key that wears 4.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: all required wires are cut
Blind says to Mute: I cut wire 4.
Deaf says: Wire 4 cut! System reports: all required wires are cut! Bomb status: Display is now 1. Indicator light is blue. Keypad still needs 1 digit (already entered 7). Positions: 1 is 1, 2 is 4, 3 is 7, 4 is 2. Mute, please signal the second keypad digit to press!

TURN 9
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then press the key that wears 7,
then cut the red wire, then press the key that wears 4.
In that order, and in no other.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Update: Display is 3, Light is green. Mute gestured press (👇) followed by 4 tallies (☝ x4). That means press the digit 4. Keypad positions: 1 is 1, 2 is 4, 3 is 7, 4 is 2. Blind: Press button 2 (the digit 4)!

I have provided all instructions from the defusal manual in the required order. Blind has been instructed by Deaf to press button 2 (digit 4), which is the final step. I will wait for the defusal to conclude.

```
wait()
```
